distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) provides the first Taiwan record of Hypothenemus seriatus, with material from Miaoli, Nantou and Taichung.

host_note: The source describes broad polyphagy on angiosperm trees, shrubs and lianes; this ecological statement is retained without converting it into inferred host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hypothenemus seriatus (Eichhoff, 1872).
